hops.requested_goal: retrieve each company's foreign currency impact disclosures
hops.rationale:
The passages in KO's 2025-filing Item 7 (FY2024 data) directly state the core foreign currency impacts: total FX impact on net operating revenues of a 5% decrease and on operating income of an 11% decrease in 2024 (4% and 8% in 2023), including hedging effects. They also give the net FX losses of $180M (2024) and $312M (2023), name the currencies behind the operating income impact, and note the expected unfavorable 2025 revenue impact. Segment-level operating income FX effects appear for EMEA (-15%) and Latin America (-17%). Still missing is the segment-level FX impact on net operating revenues, which the passages do not break out. Passages 000066 and 000039 carry the most useful support.</rationale>
